Jenna (People Ops): quick question — new hire Alicia is remote and won't have her passport until Friday. Can we still complete the I-9 for Day 1 or do we need to delay?
Liam (HR): we can do remote verification if she can present acceptable docs via video and then show originals within 3 business days. that's E-Verification friendly.
Sam - Onboarding: +1. Per policy, remote proofing OK if we follow the checklist and record the video note. Also need to log which documents were shown.
Alicia (New Hire): I can do video tomorrow morning 9am PST. I have a driver's license and my SSN card but the passport arrives Fri.
Jenna (People Ops): perfect — bring driver's license + SSN card during the live video. Sam, can you post the quick script we use so hiring manager can join?
Sam - Onboarding: here's the minimal script we follow on Zoom:
```
1) Confirm name and DOB verbally.
2) Ask to hold each ID up to camera, rotate so holograms readable.
3) Take a timestamped screenshot and note the doc types.
4) Send reminder to new hire to physically mail/scan originals within 3 business days and confirm receipt.
```
BGCheck Bot: background-check status: PENDING (vendor: CheckMate). ETA: 48-72 hours.
Jenna (People Ops): heads up — CheckMate reported a delay for batch 423 yesterday; some checks are stuck in review. If BG comes back late we can still onboard on Day 1 but must apply contingent-employment flag until cleared.
Ethan (Hiring Manager): can we still issue the welcome laptop and Slack account Day 1 if bg pending?
IT Ops: yes — we issue laptop + standard access. No elevated prod keys until BG cleared. We'll tag the account with "bg-pending" and restrict some project repos.
Maya (People Ops): also reminded payroll: if ID docs recorded but BG pending, do not finalize systems access to financial apps. Payroll, benefits enrollment should be enabled.
Liam (HR): TL;DR — for Alicia: proceed with remote I-9 via video using DL + SSN card; capture screenshots and note in BambooHR record; run BG as usual and mark hire as contingent until cleared.
Alicia (New Hire): thanks all — I'll be on Zoom at 9am PST tomorrow and I'll have the DL and SSN card ready. should I upload anything beforehand?
Sam - Onboarding: optional: upload the front/back of DL to the secure intake form at https://hr.example.com/intake (use company SSO). We still need the live video first for compliance.
Jenna (People Ops): I'll join the 9am slot to witness. Ethan, please make sure no prod creds are shared. Sam, can you follow up if CheckMate doesn't respond in 72h and advise the hiring packet?
Sam - Onboarding: on it — I'll ping CheckMate ops and loop in legal if we hit >5 business days.
Liam (HR): noted for benefits: enroll date will be hire date even if bg pending unless legal flags. Benefits team — FYI.
IT Ops: scheduled laptop imaging for Alicia on Day 1 10am PST. We will leave Slack invite open so she can join orientation.
Jenna (People Ops): thanks team. I'll update the new-hire checklist and add a note under Alicia's onboarding task: 'remote I-9 via video, docs: DL + SSN card, passport pending 2026-03-27'.
BGCheck Bot: background-check status update (1782345860): IN_REVIEW — vendor updated notes: "identity docs submitted; county court backlog for fingerprinting in progress."
Ethan (Hiring Manager): thanks. keeping this thread open until BG cleared. :thumbsup:
Sam - Onboarding: closing actions: 1) Zoom witness @9am (Jenna) 2) Alicia uploads optional scans 3) IT holds prod keys 4) Sam monitors BG vendor updates.
Jenna (People Ops): tagging for records: @Liam (HR) @Maya (People Ops) — will move to 'onboard-in-progress' when video done.
Alicia (New Hire): see you all tomorrow! :)
